# Registering your account

1. Join the [Hex Discord Server](https://dsc.gg/hexcapes)
2. Open the [#Hex](https://discord.com/channels/1387030831142277240/1510559775107055726) channel
3. Run the command:

   ```
   /register <username> <accounttype>
   ```

   Replace `username` with your Minecraft username and `accounttype` with your authentication method.

4. Wait for the confirmation message from the bot.

![image](data:image/png;base64,)


Then next step is to login and select your cape use the [catalog guide](catalog-usage.md) to learn how to use it
